items.question: What is the difference between Custom Development and Launch Accelerators?
items.answer: Custom Development involves bespoke engineering (iOS/Android mobile apps, major portals) tailored from scratch. Launch Accelerators are pre-built, conversion-optimized blueprint sites (Clinics, Gyms, Restaurants) customized and launched with WhatsApp integration and ads setup in under 7 business days.

items.question: Do I own the source code and visual designs?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. Once final payments are processed, 100% intellectual property, designs, source codes, and assets belong entirely to you with zero hidden subscription costs.

items.question: How do you track the performance and ROI of ads?
items.answer: We install advanced pixel tracking (Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, TikTok Pixel) to map exactly where your clients come from. We measure click-through rates, call acquisitions, and WhatsApp conversions to scale profitable sets.

items.question: How does the WhatsApp order and booking integration work?
items.answer: When a visitor clicks booking or ordering buttons, it compiles a structured details template (e.g., name, product, scheduled date) and forwards it directly to your business WhatsApp chat, letting you close sales instantly.
